services.kafka: 3.9.1 Apache binary distribution, single-node KRaft, Java 17

oracle: Actual broker replies, client assertions, Apache Kafka 3.9.1 message schemas and TShark 4.4.8 kafka field export
notes: No synthetic TCP wrapping or packet rewriting.
AUTH contains only a deliberately invalid test password.
RESP3 attributes and malformed/fragmentation variants use separate crafted tests, not mislabeled native captures.
native-oracle.json stores raw Kafka request/reply hex from actual sockets; semantic expectations are independently asserted in tests.
